8053.title: Parent disclosure retains invisible action width
8053.rootCauseOneLine: Parent rows select unconditional quick-action padding and retain an inline disclosure slot even when hover controls are invisible.
8053.proposedFix: Choose stable disclosure placement or explicitly accept hover movement before replacing permanent action reservation.
8053.caveats: Source-component browser reproduction in two clean checkouts; SDK icon/status glyphs stubbed, production plain-title truncation classes restored; no full app or older installed release run.
